name: Mary Rogen
source:
The owner of the Bath. She grew up in the central district and loved to stroll around different towns when she became an adult.

She is a distant relative of Benson and has had a talent for painting since birth. Her painting was on the same level as the royal painters when she was 16. She worked as a royal painter for a few years, then lost all her creativity and resigned with sickness as an excuse. Nowadays, she likes to date different people in her spare time and hopes one day she can find a love that will reactivate her passion for life.

[Edited from in-game bio]
